name: MATLAS-203 (Hubble)
blurb: MATLAS-203, an ultra-diffuse galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: matlas203-hubble
story: An ultra-diffuse galaxy found away from the crowded galaxy clusters. Hubble looked here for the globular clusters gathered around it, to test ideas about how such galaxies form.

claims.text: MATLAS-203 is a target of a Hubble program on ultra-diffuse galaxies in low-density environments
The program images UDGs in non-cluster environments to detect their globular clusters
The aim is to test models of globular cluster and galaxy formation
